-- Upsert moderation result into message_moderation_queue
INSERT INTO message_moderation_queue (message_id, chat_id, status, ai_score, flags, reason, processed_by, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ('{{ $json["message_id"] }}', '{{ $node["Load message"].json[0].chat_id }}', '{{ $json["verdict"] || ($json["body"] && $json["body"].verdict) || 'PENDING' }}', {{ $json["score"] || ($json["body"] && $json["body"].score) || 'NULL' }}, ({{ $json["flags"] || ($json["body"] && JSON.stringify($json["body"]..flags)) || 'NULL' }} )::jsonb, '{{ $json["reason"] || ($json["body"] && $json["body"].reason) || '' }}', 'ai', now(), now())
ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, ai_score = EXCLUDED.ai_score, flags = EXCLUDED.flags, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, processed_by = EXCLUDED.processed_by, updated_at = now();

-- Branch: handle BLOCKED verdict (create chat_report and audit)
INSERT INTO chat_reports (chat_id, reporter_user_id, reported_user_id, report_type, comment, report_data, created_at)
SELECT '{{ $node["Load message"].json[0].chat_id }}', NULL, '{{ $node["Load message"].json[0].sender_id }}', 'auto_moderation', 'Message blocked by AI: ' || ({{ $json["reason"] || ($json["body"] && $json["body"].reason) || '' }}), jsonb_build_object('message_id','{{ $json["message_id"] }}','flags', ({{ $json["flags"] || ($json["body"] && JSON.stringify($json["body"]..flags)) || 'null' }} )::jsonb)
WHERE '{{ $json["verdict"] || ($json["body"] && $json["body"].verdict) || 'PENDING' }}' = 'BLOCKED' RETURNING id;

-- For REVIEW: notify moderators with context (last 20 messages)
SELECT jsonb_agg(row_to_json(m)) as context FROM (SELECT id, sender_id, content, created_at FROM messages WHERE chat_id = '{{ $node["Load message"].json[0].chat_id }}' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20) m;
